market_summary: USD strength and broad risk-off sentiment dominate the New York session, leaving XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD heavily depressed well below their respective daily VWAPs and Value Areas. However, all four are severely stretched near session lows and ATR lower envelopes without fresh RVOL breakout surges, favoring patience. US100 completed a sharp extension into session highs above VAH before printing a strong rejection off Call Wall #1 under a Positive Dampening GEX regime, presenting a clean mean-reversion short scalp back toward the baseline.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3917.46) and POC (3978.13), indicating sustained value-area expansion lower. CVD is -8.25 (BEARISH), agreeing with the strong downtrend. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is firmly below VWAP (3940.64) and EMA50 (3927.13), hugging the lower ATR band (3871.65). RVOL is normal (0.91), but options GEX is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price hovering just above Gamma Flip (3866.79) and significant Put Wall support down at 3814.15. However, since price is compressed right on the Gamma Flip and Session Low (3852.35) after a massive extended flush, reward-to-risk for further breakdown is exhausted without a pullback.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of EMA20/ATR lower band retest

signals.rationale: Price trades below VAL (1.10760) and POC (1.10943). Cumulative Delta shows CVD +355 (NEUTRAL), displaying slight divergence against the sell-off. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading under downward-sloping VWAP (1.10822) and EMA50 (1.10826). The forming bar is hovering right near the lower ATR band (1.10580) and testing Session Low support at 1.10533 without strong yellow RVOL breakout volume (RVOL 1.169). Lacking CVD agreement and directly bouncing from session lows, holding is preferred over chasing a bottom.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sustained below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is positioned well below VAL (1.32545) and POC (1.32731). CVD is -9,698 (BEARISH), confirming seller dominance. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Trend is strictly bearish below both VWAP (1.32592) and EMA50 (1.32598). Bars are pressing down near the lower ATR envelope (1.32302) toward Session Low at 1.32210. While trend is strong, current RVOL is moderate (1.117) and price is stretched into major session support with positive forming bar wicks, demanding caution against selling the literal lows.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish strong below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below S/R 1.32500 and lower ATR

signals.rationale: Price is trading well above VAH (28218.78) and POC (28122.95). CVD is +2.81 (NEUTRAL). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28148.18) and EMA50 (28175.91). RVOL is 1.047 (standard for Dukascopy index CFD tick volume). In GEX context, regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price above Gamma Flip (28224.55), but the signal candle tapped Session High 28550.97 and rejected sharply, sliding back through Call Wall #1 (28430.51) and upper ATR band (28444.00). Under positive gamma, dealers damp moves, favoring mean reversion pullback toward EMA20/VWAP.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish expansion above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection off Session High 28550.97 into Call Wall #1

signals.rationale: Price sits well below VAL (72515.53) and POC (73501.60). CVD is -0.07 (BEARISH), reflecting prevailing downside bias. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is under downward VWAP (72931.89) and EMA50 (72732.66). However, price has paused after testing the lower ATR band (71381.12), oscillating above Session Low (71141.0). RVOL is low at 1.059 with no yellow breakout volume. Entering short here risks selling into an oversold base right on session support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish consolidation near lows below VWAP and EMA50
